extensionAttribute.description: Firmware password mode: "none", "command", or "full". Returns "N/A" on Apple Silicon (no firmware password concept).
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # EFI Password Mode Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel only # Apple Silicon doesn't expose a firmware-password mode in the same sense # (boot security is governed by the Startup Security Utility / 1TR), so we # return N/A on arm64. On Intel + T2, firmwarepasswd reported the mode # until macOS 14 removed it; we read nvram directly as the canonical source.
if [[ "$(/usr/bin/uname -m)" == "arm64" ]]; then echo "<result>N/A</result>" exit 0 fi
mode=$(/usr/sbin/nvram -p 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/awk '/security-mode/ { print $2; exit }')
echo "<result>${mode:-none}</result>"
